newsitem.title: USA: AES Chigen completes $180 mln offering.
newsitem.headline: AES Chigen completes $180 mln offering.

text.p: AES China Generating Co Ltd said on Friday that it completed a $180 million public offering of senior unsecured notes.
The notes bear interest at a rate of 10-1/8 percent, are payable semi-annually, and due in December 2006. The notes have been rated BB- and Ba3 by Standard & Poor's and Moody's.

Morgan Stanley & Co Inc served as lead manager of the issue. The company said that proceeds after the prefunding of interest and funding of a debt service reserve account would be used to fund equity investments in power projects and for general corporate purposes.
